The affix खश् is used after the verb पच् 'to cook' when मित 'a measured partition' or नख 'a nail' is the word in composition with it as an object.

Terms: खश्

The final vowel of विश्व is lengthened before मित्र when it is the name of a ऋषि।

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

The roots having an indicatory म् retain their penultimate short vowel before the causative णि।

Terms: ऊ substitution
